options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Goal Tournament
options.doc: Which tournament must be won to complete the seed.

options.name: Starting HAR
options.doc: Which HAR the player begins with. Random picks one of the 11 at generation time.

options.name: Available HARs
options.doc:
How many of the 11 HARs are included in the multiworld. Chosen randomly at generation,
always including the starting HAR. 11 = all HARs (default). Minimum 1.
options.doc_fr: Combien des 11 HAR sont inclus dans le multimonde. Choix aléatoire à la génération, incluant toujours le HAR de départ. 11 = tous les HAR (par défaut). Minimum 1.

options.name: HAR Stat Max
options.doc: Maximum upgrade level for each HAR stat. Vanilla = 9.

options.name: Pilot Stat Max
options.doc: Maximum upgrade level for each pilot stat. Vanilla = 25.

options.name: Buy Cost Factor
options.doc:
cost multiplier of vanilla Mechlab prices (divide by 100 for precentage). 
100 = vanilla prices. 200 = 2x prices Range 1–1000 (0.01×–10×).

options.name: Money (Small) Value
options.doc:
Base credit value for a Money (Small) item. Each Money (Small) item received
credits this amount (plus money_small_step growth) to every HAR's wallet at once,
not just the currently active HAR.
options.doc_fr: Valeur de base du crédit pour un poste Monnaie (Petit). Chaque article d'argent (petit) a été crédité de ce montant (plus la croissance money small step) au portefeuille de chaque HAR à la fois, pas seulement le HAR actuellement actif.

options.name: Money (Large) Value
options.doc:
Base credit value for a Money (Large) item. Each Money (Large) item received
credits this amount (plus money_large_step growth) to every HAR's wallet at once,
not just the currently active HAR.
options.doc_fr: Valeur de base du crédit pour un poste Argent (Grand). Chaque article d'argent (large) a été crédité de ce montant (plus la croissance money large step) au portefeuille de chaque HAR à la fois, pas seulement le HAR actuellement actif.

options.name: Money (Small) Growth Step
options.doc:
Extra credits added to the Money (Small) award for each Money (Small) item
already received this game (0 = every check is worth exactly money_small_value).
options.doc_fr: Des crédits supplémentaires ajoutés au prix Argent (petit) pour chaque article Argent (petit) déjà reçu ce jeu (0 = chaque chèque vaut exactement argent petit valeur).

options.name: Money (Large) Growth Step
options.doc:
Extra credits added to the Money (Large) award for each Money (Large) item
already received this game (0 = every check is worth exactly money_large_value).
options.doc_fr: Des crédits supplémentaires ajoutés au prix Money (Grand) pour chaque article Money (Grand) déjà reçu ce jeu (0 = chaque chèque vaut exactement argent large value).

options.name: Shop Hints
options.doc:
When enabled, focusing a shop upgrade button broadcasts a hint to the AP server
so all players can see what item is at that location. When disabled, the item name
is still shown in-game but no hint is sent to the server.

options.name: Difficulty
options.doc: AI difficulty for tournament opponents. Matches the four OMF difficulty tiers.
options.doc_fr: Difficulté AI pour les adversaires du tournoi. Correspond aux quatre niveaux de difficulté OMF.
